Name: (FS) Two-Toned Hair Overlays for Fashion Sense
Author: TeddyIsTired
Description:
[b][size=4]What is this?[/size][/b]
This mod adds colorable pieces of vanilla hairstyles as accessories to Fashion Sense. This way you can have funky two-toned hair in any color combination you desire!
Currently there is a selection of 27 hairstyles with a total of 51 variants available.

[center][size=4][i]Requests are[/i][b][i] [color=green]OPEN[/color]
[/i][/b][/size][size=1][b][i][color=#616161](check further down for request instructions)[/color][/i][/b][/size][/center]


[b][size=4]What you need[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=description]SMAPI [/url]﻿4.0.8 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=description]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ 6.3.4 or later[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How does is work?[/b][/size]
[size=4][size=2][i]Step 1:[/i]  ﻿choose the hair you want to wear in character creation (at the start of the game or at the shrine of illusions)[/size][/size]
[size=4][b]  ﻿  ﻿  or[/b][/size]
[size=2]download "[FS] Vanilla Hair for Two-Toned Overlays" from the optional files - this way you can swap between hairstyles and the corresponding accessories all within Fashion Sense[/size]

[size=2][i]Step 2:[/i]  ﻿get the Fashion Sense hand mirror
(on a new safe you can choose to start with the mirror and will receive it in the mail. otherwise you can buy it at Pierre's.)[/size]
[size=2]
[i]Step 3:[/i]  ﻿under accessories choose the colored hair piece you want to wear and color it
(if you have the optional file also choose the corresponding hairstyle under the hair tab and color that too!)[/size]
[size=2]
[i]Enjoy!
[/i][/size]
[size=4][b]This mod currently includes
[/b][/size][size=3][i]Check images for reference!
[i][size=1](If you want to make your FS less cluttered you can delete any folders of the hairstyles you don't need!)[/size][/i][/i][/size]
